title: Seat Change Reversal Charges When a Microsoft 365 Subscription Is Cancelled
content:
For license work not covered by ClearPath, every seat addition recorded on a cancelled Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription is reversed with the cancellation as a separate Partner Center change. A seat change charge is deducted from the cancellation refund for each one:

- **5.00 USD for each** when there are one or two seat additions;
- **4.00 USD for each** when there are three or more;
- **nothing** when there are none.

The seat additions counted are all those recorded among the subscription's license changes.

**Covered work.** License work is covered by ClearPath for a client holding a ClearPath agreement whose status is active or notice given and whose tier includes Microsoft 365 administration. For such a client, no seat change charge is deducted.

## Charge table (license work not covered)

| Seat additions recorded | Rate | Charge deducted |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | — | nothing |
| 1 | 5.00 USD each | 5.00 USD |
| 2 | 5.00 USD each | 10.00 USD |
| 3 | 4.00 USD each | 12.00 USD |
| 5 | 4.00 USD each | 20.00 USD |

At three seat additions the lower rate of 4.00 USD applies to every one of them, not only to the third.
